title: groupTrackerProcesses
responsibility: Groups CPU and resident memory by agent session, simulator, orphaned Harness test helpers and otherwise unassigned process.

inputs.name: parseTrackerProcesses.text
inputs.description: Output of ps with process id, parent id, resident KB, CPU percent and command name on each line.

inputs.name: classifyTrackerProcess.name
inputs.description: Command name of the process without its directory.

inputs.name: classifyTrackerProcess.args
inputs.description: Full command line, only matched against and never returned. Defaults to empty.

inputs.name: groupTrackerProcesses.rows
inputs.description: Parsed process table of one computer.

inputs.name: groupTrackerProcesses.argsByPid
inputs.description: Command line of each process id, used only to classify processes.

inputs.name: groupTrackerProcesses.panes
inputs.description: tmux session name of each pane process id, used to label groups.

inputs.name: groupTrackerSystemProcesses.rows
inputs.description: Process table rows with parent IDs, CPU percentages and resident memory.

inputs.name: groupTrackerSystemProcesses.argsByPid
inputs.description: Local command lines used to identify simulator and orphaned test helpers. The groups carry no command lines.

inputs.name: groupTrackerSystemProcesses.agents
inputs.description: Agent roots whose usage is accounted for separately.

outputs.name: parseTrackerProcesses
outputs.description: One row for each readable line; other lines are skipped.

outputs.name: classifyTrackerProcess
outputs.description: Claude, Codex, test runner or browser, or undefined for any other process.

outputs.name: groupTrackerProcesses
outputs.description: One group for each outermost agent session, test runner or browser, with process count, CPU and memory.
